Harper Lee: Quick company-wide note  were updating the Compassionate Leave & Emergency Travel portion of the handbook. Effective 2026-08-01: expanded travel support for bereavement and urgent family medical events. Full policy: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/compassionate-leave (TL;DR below)

Noah Kim: Thanks Harper. Whats changing exactly?

Harper Lee: Short bullets: 1) Bereavement travel stipend up to $1,000 per event for immediate family travel (covers airfare/hotel/ground). 2) Emergency medical travel: up to $800 per trip when you must travel for a dependents urgent care. 3) Up to 5 days paid Compassionate Leave for bereavement; managers can approve additional unpaid leave per local laws. 4) Applies to FT employees and eligible PT (>=0.6 FTE); contractors excluded.

Zoe Park: How do we submit claims and whats the expense code?

Harper Lee: Use Concur -> Expenses -> New -> COMP-TRAV. Attach receipt(s), brief justification (one-line), and manager approval screenshot. Finance will fast-track COMP-TRAV claims; expect processing in 3-7 business days.

Finance Team: Note: for international receipts, include a conversion screenshot or bank statement line. Well map COMP-TRAV to a separate ledger so manager travel budgets arent affected.

Samir (Legal): A couple of legal points: 1) Immigration/visa fees are excluded unless pre-approved for mission-critical cases. 2) For some jurisdictions, travel reimbursements may be taxable; Payroll will review per-claim. 3) Do not upload sensitive medical docs into Concur; a manager-certified note is sufficient for eligibility review.

Noah Kim: Retroactive coverage? I had to fly out for a family emergency in July.

Harper Lee: Retroactive window: claims for events on or after 2026-07-15 will be considered if filed by 2026-08-15 with manager confirmation. Older cases can be submitted for exceptional review.

Zoe Park: Managers: what should we look for when approving?

Harper Lee: Approve only when the travel is clearly tied to bereavement or urgent family medical needs. If unsure, ask the employee to DM People Ops for a quick eligibility check. Managers will see COMP-TRAV as a separate line item.

hr-bot: :white_check_mark: "Compassionate Leave & Emergency Travel" update published at https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/compassionate-leave. Effective date: 2026-08-01. Questions: people-ops@redwood.com

Samir (Legal): Practical tip: for cross-border events, include the country and dates in the expense note so Payroll can tag tax treatment appropriately.

Noah Kim: Appreciate this. Also, can Compassionate Leave run concurrent with PTO?

Harper Lee: Yes — employees may elect to use PTO during Compassionate Leave days; PTO use does not extend paid bereavement entitlement. If you need extra time beyond policy, talk to your manager and People Ops.

Zoe Park: Will People Ops run an info session?

Harper Lee: Yep  one 30-min town hall next Wed 10am PT and a recording will be posted. RSVP on the calendar.

Noah Kim: Thanks 44d

Harper Lee: Thanks all. Sending the short digest into #announcements shortly. If you have a sensitive case, email people-ops@redwood.com and well handle privately. :heart:
